# Henrique Santana

> Principal Cloud Support Engineer at AWS. Containers, Kubernetes, AI/ML infrastructure. KubeCon and re:Invent speaker. Co-founder of Cloud Native Dublin.

## About

Personal website and blog of Henrique Santana, covering AI-assisted development workflows, cloud architecture, and container orchestration.

## Blog Posts

- [What You Leave Out of the Context Matters More](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/what-you-leave-out-of-context.html): Context is a budget with a cost per item. Past a threshold, more material makes the model average across inputs and hedge. The skill is curation.
- [AI Made Me Faster, Not Better](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/ai-made-me-faster-not-better.html): AI tools amplify the engineer using them, they do not set the quality bar. Same assistant, two engineers, opposite outcomes. The tool changes speed, not standard.
- [Gates That Block, or None](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/gates-that-block-or-none.html): Every quality check in an AI pipeline should be binary pass/fail. A gate either stops the output from shipping, or it should not exist.
- [Your AI Agent Is a New Hire](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/agents-need-guardrails.html): An AI agent with API access and a deploy key is a new hire with no judgment and infinite confidence. The fix is the same boring guardrails we apply to humans.
- [One Agent Per Dimension](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/one-agent-per-dimension.html): Six focused agents each checking a single dimension produce sharper feedback than one generalist reviewer, and run in parallel.
- [AI Catches Errors It Just Made](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/ai-catches-its-own-lies.html): The same model that fabricates a claim will flag it as wrong in a fresh session. I use that asymmetry as my primary workflow now.
- [I Built a Tool to Score My LinkedIn Profile](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/linkedin-profile-score.html): I turned a recruiter's profile optimization guide into a scoring tool that reads your LinkedIn data export and tells you exactly what to fix.
- [Skills, Not Prompts](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/skills-not-prompts.html): Why skill-based workflows replaced free-prompting for all my active projects.
- [SEO Now Has Two Audiences](https://henriquesantana.work/blog/seo-for-ai-agents.html): Your website has two types of visitors now: humans and AI agents. Most sites are only optimized for one.
